text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wooo... What a development. Who
would've
thought the "Princess Fighter
vs Spy Catz" writers
could pull off a
shocker like that?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right?! The Spy Catz were really
something! Their
recon was so on point
that they learned all of
Princess Fighter's
moves!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They did some recon, and learned some
moves...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Time to hit the track! I'll give you
all a
special up-close look at the Teio
Step!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Teio always has such a spring in
her step.
It's almost as if her legs have
actual springs in
them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if emulating her would make
me even
lovelier.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your acceleration needs work. Widen
your stride.
Here, I'll demonstrate.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove puts so much force into each
step, it's
almost as if she's about launch
herself into flight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A flying Machan would probably be a
big hit...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Aston Machan and I are training
as usual,
but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Whew... Well, what did you think?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! That's because I'm the
new-and-improved
Mega Machan. But
you can call me "Machan" for
short.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's a pleasure to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea how, but Aston Machan's
improved
almost overnight. If she keeps
this up, there's no
telling how good
she'll get!
